He realized that Beyblading is all about honor and individuality, and he made it his new goal to bring Beyblading to the masses. That's why he took over the BBA and turned it into BEGA ' as a way to give children around the world that had no exposure to the game a chance to better their lives and become champions themselves. Tyson is still skeptical, and his bad-mouthing of Boris draws the ire of a top BEGA prospect ' a juggernaut named Crusher, whose Beyblade launcher is the biggest one the boys have ever seen. When grilled by Tyson about his motives for joining this professional league, Crusher admits he's doing it for the prospect of getting rich, but only so he can afford to pay his younger sister's hospital bills. A Beybattle ensues, and Crusher shows he's even more powerful than he looks. Tyson is nearly defeated, but he summons his will and narrowly defeats his jumbo-sized opponent. When Boris asks Tyson if he now believes he's sincere in his reasons for creating BEGA, Tyson still isn't sure. But Tyson does admit that if spirited and honorable Blader's like Crusher are in it, maybe there is some merit in the new league after all.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger wanders the woods of White Tiger Hills, the headquarters of the White Tiger X team, and although this strange young man performs incredible good deeds, Lee and the rest of the team are suspicious, and tell their leader Ray, all about him. It isn't long until the entire team meets up with him again, and Ray comes face to face with the stranger's incredible abilities like leaping, flying and jumping through the air, not to mention Beyblading like a world champion. He calls himself Mystel and amazes Lee and Ray with the mixture of his incredible acrobatics and Beyblading skills. Lee imagines how good the White Tiger X team would be if they knew how to move like Mystel, and, after challenging their new guest to a battle, has high hopes that he'll share his secrets. But Lee is humiliated by a quick loss, and now it's up to Ray to represent the team in it's own backyard! Can he beat Mystel, and more importantly, can he find out the secrets behind this mysterious young Beyblader?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson can't seem to make up his mind whether or not to trust Boris and go pro. When the team is visited by a rabid pack of sponsors who want to sign them to product contracts, Grandpa is forced to step in and recommend that Tyson have a talk with his more experienced brother, Hiro. While looking for Hiro, Tyson and friends come across Tala, Bryan and Spencer, who are on their way to get revenge on Boris by bringing the BEGA league down around him. Tyson is torn between following Tala, and respecting Tala's wish that he stay out of it.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: An intense battle is played out on the stadium floor, when, it looks like Tala is about to lose, bars rise up out of the floor and keep him in the dish. As they continue to battle, Tala becomes weaker and weaker and collapses. Tyson's had enough. He yells out at Boris telling him his whole BEGA outfit is bogus and he challenges the shadowy figure to a battle. Boris accepts the challenges and at stake is the future of the BEGA and Tyson's future as a Beyblader!! Most of Tyson's friends surround him in a show of support, except one. Kai walks out of the stands and walks right by Tyson leaving him high and dry!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In response to Tyson's challenge of a one on one battle against the best Blader in BEGA, Boris counters by suggesting a five on five match. Tyson wants to accept but the odds are stacked against him. Kai has now joined the BEGA Blader's and BEGA now virtually controls the whole sport because they have set up an I.D. registration service for all Blader's who want to become professionals. Worst of all, Hiro, Tyson's brother has been hired on to coach the BEGA Blader's! Tyson tells his troubles to Ray but gets no sympathy. Secretly Ray has always wanted to battle Tyson when he was at his championship best so he challenges his old friend. An intense battle ensues with Tyson eventually coming out the winner. Ray is satisfied but his blade and Tyson's is ruined. With no hope of getting replacement parts the team decides to build their own blades and go face the BEGA Blader's in battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Hiro stuns the world by joining the BEGA League and coaching Brooklyn, their secret weapon. As the popularity of the new league rises, BBA Revolution find themselves unable to practice because Boris has cornered the market on new parts. Boris is satisfied with the progress of his top Blader's, who are training heavily in a series of practice and exhibition matches. Ming Ming and the rest of her teammates easily dispatch the competition.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. These former foes don't like Boris and his professional BEGA league either, seeing this new entity as a threat to the sport of Beyblading. They vow to help Tyson and the other members of the BBA Revolution in whatever way they can to overthrow BEGA.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they once came across, that they realize the secret of reining in their new spinners'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max and Ray struggle to learn the 'Hard Metal' system with the help of some of their friends from the World Championship tournament. They still need one more member for the team, and Rick, Lee and Michael have all volunteered to fill the remaining slot. But first they have to prove they can master the new system'which proves a lot tougher than they thought.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bega Bladers have one more Blader to pick for the BEGA 5 Justice Tournament and it's between the up and coming Brooklyn and Kai. As their elimination battle begins, Kai tries his best to take command but it seems Brooklyn mirrors his every move. Kai realizes something's fishy, but before he can do anything about it, Brooklyn takes the win, much to Boris's liking.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the start of 'Justice 5' and Daichi is set to battle Ming Ming, the crowd favorite because of her cute demeanor and sensational singing voice. Daichi's goal is to prove that Ming Ming doesn't take Beyblading seriously and he vows to knock her out of the stadium early in the match. However, when Ming Ming gains the upper hand this makes Daichi very annoyed. Worst of all, Ming Ming has the nerve to break into song as if to mock Daichi. Even worse, her singing seems to make her Blading improve and she slams Strata Dragoon relentlessly. Kenny, a devoted fan of Ming Ming's, realizes that it's her voice that helps her concentrate on her blade and Tyson tells Daichi of her secret. Daichi uses his own voice to unleash the full power of Strata Dragoon but in the end Ming Ming proves to be the better blader and wins the match. Daichi is disappointed but being a good sportsman he congratulates Ming Ming. Tyson and the others realize that the Bega Bladers intend to fight fairly and they all vow to do their very best to win the next battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the second match of the Justice Five Battle and Ray and Crusher are facing off against each other. With Ming Ming's win against Daichi in the previous match, the BEGA League is already ahead by one so the pressure is on Ray to take the match. But Crusher is feeling the pressure too, not only for himself and his teammates but for his sister, Monica, who is undergoing surgery at the very same time. From the beginning, the battle is fierce with both Blader's inflicting significant damage. But Ray quickly gains the upper hand and it looks like its game over. It is only once Crusher calls upon the spirit of his brave, little sister that he is filled with the courage and strength necessary to match Ray. But with so much at stake, which Blader will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first two matches of the 'Justice 5' tournament are complete, and things aren't looking good for Tyson's squad, G Revolutions. BEGA's team is up two games to one in the best-of-five series. If they lose another match, BEGA will be victorious and have complete control over the sport of Beyblading. This puts a lot of pressure on Max to win game three against Mystel. Tyson and the others argue whether Max's signature defensive style will be enough to overcome Mystel's unpredictable and overpowering attack. Max takes this as a sign that his teammates only think he can win if he changes the way he Beyblades altogether. His confidence shattered, Max isolates himself and does some soul-searching. He receives a morale boost from a unlikely source ' Rick, his contentious PPB All Starz partner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three rounds already played, the G Revolutions team finds themselves with an unimpressive record' two matches lost, and one ending in a draw. Tyson and the rest of the team are practicing furiously to guarantee a check in the win column for tomorrow's big match. The bad news is, no one on the team has the same skill with the Hard Metal Beyblade as Tyson does' or at least that's what he thinks, and he refuses to choose any of his teammates to Blade in the last round of the tournament, insisting instead to blade both rounds himself. As all of the others vie for the last spot, Kai's frustration at his lack of control with his new Hard Metal Beyblade reaches an all-time high, combine that with his anger at what happened to Tala, and Kai's mood is even less cheery than usual. It isn't until he connects with an unlikely Blading opponent that he gains the technique he's been seeking for so long'the real question is, will Tyson and the rest of the gang welcome Kai back after all they've been through in the past?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the continuation of the Justice 5 Tournament with the BEGA Blader's leading the battle with two wins and a tie. If G Revolutions lose the next battle, they're out and BEGA (lead by the evil Boris) takes over the Beyblading Empire. The next battle is set to pit Tyson against Garland, but when the G Revolutions enter the stadium, they reveal their fifth team member- KAI!! Everyone is stunned, except for the BEGA Blader's who see him only as a loser. Kai is out for revenge because a few days earlier he lost a battle to Brooklyn. So, wanting to save face, Kai calls out Brooklyn, who arrogantly accepts his challenge. A massive battle ensues with Kai trying desperately to somehow attack his opponent, but nothing seems to work. And what's worse, Brooklyn seems to be copying Kai's every move. Kai becomes frustrated and realizes he must dig deep within himself to draw out more power. He does, however, it's making him weaker and weaker. The rest of the G Revolutions team wants him to quit. Kai refuses and in the end, he prepares for a final assault against his foe!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The battle of 'Justice 5 Tournament' continues and Kai is clearly overwhelmed by the power of Brooklyn of the Bega Bladers. Attack after attack sees Kai barely hanging on as he fights to stay in the match. Tyson and his team mates nervously watch, but vow to stay out of the battle because of a promise that Tyson made to Kai. Pleased with the progress of the battle and confident that Brooklyn will win, Boris watches from the sidelines with delight. Kai's determination to win against these unbeatable odds begins to frustrate Brooklyn and he increases the intensity of his attacks. Suddenly, when it seems that Kai can't take any more he manages to draw upon his Beyblading spirit and defeat Brooklyn. The crowd goes wild at this dramatic upset and Kai leaves the stadium only to collapse into Tyson's arms, battered and bruised. Brooklyn remains in the stadium, stunned and confused after suffering the first defeat of his Beyblading career. Kai assures his concerned team mates that he's all right and tells Tyson that he should be more concerned with his upcoming battle against Garland. Tyson, as confident as ever, shrugs Kai's advice off but secretly hopes he can summon the same amazing strength that his old friend showed in his battle. Kai walks unsteadily out of the stadium alone, collapses again, and then watches as Dranzer disintegrates in front of him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: All of G Revolutions hopes now rest on Tyson's match with Garland. Tyson is determined to make sure Kai's brave victory over Brooklyn isn't wasted. Garland is confident he will win. His family have been sports champions for centuries thanks to a book containing the Tzebult Principles of Victory. Those who follow the principles never lose! Tyson seeks the help of his friends to prepare, finding comfort and focus in their company. The match begins and Garland seems unbeatable due to the family principles. But Tyson isn't satisfied' he wants to fight the real Garland, not a book of rules. Tyson convinces Garland to abandon the family code and Beybattle like a true Blader. But can he withstand the full force of Garland unleashed?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Brooklyn has gone a little loopy after his loss against Kai. And the loss means either BEGA or the G Revolutions need one more victory to win the Justice 5 Tournament. To determine a winner, one battle is left and it will pit Tyson going up against one of the BEGA Blader's. But who will it be? Garland offers his services, but Hiro turns him down cold saying they need Brooklyn to fight this battle. Brooklyn's on the brink of a breakdown and now it's up to Hiro to get him back into fighting form.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match between the G Revolutions and the BEGA Bladers has arrived. Tyson prepares for the contest, unsure of whom he will ultimately face. It isn't until he steps onto the stadium floor when he discovers that he will go face to face, against Brooklyn himself. Brooklyn shows off his incredible powers immediately, stunning both teams on either side of the Beystadium. But no one has any idea of the true extent of Brooklyn's powers until he creates a wormhole to another dimension, creating an empty shell, carbon copy of the real world! The freak out continues as Brooklyn destroys everything in his new empty world to mold it into an image that makes him happy! Tyson has never faced an opponent like this! Does he stand a chance, or will BEGA continue its evil infection of the Beyblading community?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's mid-way through Tyson and Brooklyn's final tie-breaking 'Justice 5' match which could give BEGA a stranglehold on the entire sport of Beyblading. Having suffered his only previous defeat at the hands of Kai, Brooklyn's thirst for revenge takes the form of an unearthly power. Not only has his Beyblade Zeus given Brooklyn sinister black wings with which to fly, it's generated a giant vortex in the sky that is wreaking havoc on the city. Buildings are crumbling everywhere. The entire world is being enveloped by the growing darkness. Only Tyson can stop Brooklyn before it's too late. Summoning his own formidable power from Dragoon, Tyson flies into the sky to convince Brooklyn to cease the negative emotions that are causing the havoc. When reasoning fails, the pair continues their battle above the ever-crumbling city. The tide turns in Tyson's favor when he's able to summon the spirits of his teammates' blades and merge them with Dragoon, which evolves into the most powerful Beyblade ever. By probing deeper into Brooklyn's psyche, Tyson learns that his foe's anxiety stems from childhood isolation at being a genius so early in life. Tyson makes Brooklyn see that Beyblading is a pure sport to be enjoyed for one reason alone ' the love of the game. Brooklyn calms down. The chaos ends. And the pair continues their match simply for enjoyment. With BEGA's HQ in shambles, the upstart league and its owner Boris are ruined. Mr. Dickenson's BBA league restarts, but in a much more modest form. And kids everywhere ' including Tyson and his friends - return to the simple, purest form of Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Terror in Resonance [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: As the light of the sun vanishes, Mustang learns the loss which comes from seeing the other side of the Gateway - and five sacrifices gather in the dark presence of the Father.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: The light is gone. Shadows swallow everything. As the planet quakes and the heavens tremble, the souls of heroes and villains alike vanish into darkness. The circle is complete.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Millions of lifeless bodies litter the landscape of Amestris, and a being with the power to create suns is unleashed upon the world. Unless Hohenheim has something amazing up his sleeve, all is surely lost.

programme.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Tanjiro and Nezuko, along with Zenitsu and Inosuke, join one of the most powerful swordsmen within the Demon Slayer Corps, Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, to face the demon aboard the Mugen Train on track to despair.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: After an encounter with Dr. Eggman, Sonic finds himself unable to stop running. Chris and his grandfather Chuck soon discover that Eggman's E-88 is behind Sonic's problem.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Chris finds himself depressed at the prospect of his friends returning to their home world despite knowing that it is what's best for them. Meanwhile, Knuckles attempts to orchestrate a truce between Sonic and Eggman so that they can all return home.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Eggman takes Chris hostage after tricking Knuckles and Chris into giving him all six Chaos Emeralds discovered. Eggman and Sonic face off once more as Sonic seeks to save Chris and prevent Eggman from obtaining the final Emerald.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin meets the grandson of master Ukiyoe artist, Toushusai Sharaku and learns that he has been switching his own works with his grandfather's originals. Unable to switch the last painting due to illness, he asks Lupin to switch it in his stead. Will Lupin be able to pull off the switch and what will happen to the original Ukiyoe paintings?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin and Fujiko have been invited to a party hosted by Marcel Dulane, a member of Paris' high society. However, the elegant party turns out to be a trap. Fujiko is taken hostage and Lupin, with a time-bomb belt strapped to his waist, is ordered to steal a certain file from Scotland Yard. Will Lupin be able to infiltrate Scotland Yard and save Fujiko, all before the bomb belt detonates?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: It's the Ability Assessment tests for Ishiyama High, the den of delinquents. Oga tries studying for the test, for once. Baby Beel and Hilda have gotten used to various customs in the Human World and report on Baby Beel's growth to the Great Demon Lord.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kanzaki is thinking hard about why he's unable to be a match for Oga, and tries to perfect a new special move, when Shiroyama realizes the crucial difference... Oga has a baby on his back! Shiroyama and Natsume help Kanzaki go through intense "BoB" training!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga hears about the legendary Tojo, the final and strongest member of Ishiyama's TKKH, from Furuichi. And right away, he goes for a showdown! Well, if he knew where Tojo was. Thanks to Himekawa's digging, Oga, Hilda, and the rest head to the beach where Tojo is supposed to be working part-time...

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. programme.title: Cardboard Boxer
programme.desc: Willie (Thomas Haden Church) is a goodhearted man living rough on the dangerous streets of Los Angeles’ Skid Row and finds himself coerced by two rich teenagers into fighting other homeless men for cash. Stuck in a violent world he doesn’t fully understand, Willie finds solace when he discovers the discarded diary of a troubled young girl and befriends a homeless veteran, Pinky (Boyd Holbrook). A cab driver named Pope (Terrence Howard) lends Willie a blanket, looks after his friends on the street, and is protective of this little world normally condemned to invisibility. Academy Award nominees Thomas Haden Church and Terrence Howard join GONE GIRL actor Boyd Holbrook in Knate Lee’s (BAD GRANDPA, JACKASS 3D) directorial debut, a powerful tale of loss, redemption, and friendship.

programme.title: Believe: The Barack Obama Story
programme.desc: Believe: The Barack Obama Story is an intimate portrait of the life of Barack Obama that details his early life in Hawaii as well as his meteoric rise in politics culminating with his historic victory in the 2008 Presidential election.

programme.title: Baselines
programme.desc: Set in Los Angeles, this series follows Jamiel Chambers, a blue chip high-schooler on the brink of escaping the desperate poverty that has berated inner city America. After his junior year ends with him leading his team to a second place finish in the state's regional tournament, Jamiel is hand-picked to play in the city's annual summer league All-Star game. With college recruits swarming and pro agents hedging, the media circus leans in, peddling the question mark around his future like rabid bookies. It is this exposure that gets the attention of Nick Collins, a derelict from a disreputable family from neighboring Irvine. After his doomed-from-the-start plan to capitalize on Jamiel's notoriety ends in with fatal results, family members from both sides are pulled into a series of events which will not only effect Jamiel's trajectory, but will set up one of the most intense family feuds the city has ever witnessed.

programme.desc: Con ayuda de Louis, Molloy rememora los momentos de su pasado que más daño le hacen durante la primera entrevista que mantienen, en 1973.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: En París, Claudia pide un complejo favor a Louis. Mientras tanto, Armand intenta mantener el control dentro de un clan que se encuentra cada vez más inconforme. En Dubái, aumenta la tensión entre Louis y Armand.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: El clan abre un juicio cuyo resultado parece escrito antes incluso de comenzar, pero el testigo principal no recita el testimonio que le habían ordenado narrar.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: Molloy cuestiona las consecuencias del juicio de Louis y Claudia. Armand es ridiculizado por haber ayudado a Louis.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En Oceanside, el grupo continúa entrenando en caso de que los Susurradores regresen. Las tensiones aumentan, mientras los supervivientes tratan de aferrarse a lo que queda en pie de su concepto de civilización.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Se revela el origen de Alpha y Beta. Además, Alpha intenta endurecer a Lydia a medida que se preparan para caminar junto a los muertos, y los Susurradores crean sus hordas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La creciente amenaza del regreso de los Susurradores dispara la paranoia en Alejandría. Además, Carol lucha contra su sed de venganza.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Desaparecen provisiones de Hilltop. Además, un habitante de Alejandría idolatra a Negan. Ezekiel guarda un secreto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol y Daryl emprenden una misión juntos. Mientras tanto, Siddiq intenta resolver un misterio.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol provoca que Daryl se sienta absolutamente incómodo. Alpha y Beta tienen dudas sobre una persona.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo debe averiguar cómo salir de una situación peligrosa.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo debe defender a Alejandría de una fuerza amenazante.

programme.desc: Tras el encuentro de Daryl y Lydia con Alpha, los habitantes de las comunidades enfrentadas a los Susurradores, que se aproximan a la Cumbre, tienen dos opciones: huir o pelear. Entretanto, surgen problemas entre Eugene y Stephanie.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Michonne devuelve a Virgil a la isla misteriosa de la que proviene para que se reencuentre con su familia. A cambio, Virgil promete que le entregará un arsenal que cambiará el rumbo de la guerra contra los Susurradores.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Michonne lleva a Virgil de regreso a su misteriosa isla para reunirse con su familia. A cambio, Virgil promete armas que podrían cambiar el rumbo de la Guerra de los Susurradores.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Todos, héroes y villanos, se adaptan a las consecuencias del devastador incendio que destruyó la comunidad. Eugene encabeza a un grupo que parte en busca de Stephanie, guiados por la esperanza de encontrar otra civilización.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Princesa asusta a los caballos de Eugene, Yumiko y Ezequiel, pero les promete otro medio de transporte. Mientras, Beta, en estado de delirio psicótico, guía a la horda de zombis hacia Alejandría para destruirlo todo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los seguidores de Beta se acercan a las puertas, y parte del grupo se impregna de sangre de zombi para intentar escapar entre la multitud de caminantes y regresar con ayuda. Sin embargo, los susurradores se mueven con cuchillos entre los zombis.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Maggie regresa, para consternación de Negan. Los desafíos que superó desde su partida han hecho que se vuelva difícil sobrevivir para ella y su hijo. Por otro lado, Daryl y Maggie luchan inesperadamente contra una amenaza invisible y desconocida.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Carol encuentran una vieja cabaña que provoca que Daryl recuerde sus años alejados del grupo después de que Rick desapareció. Además, revive el doloroso recuerdo de encontrarse con un sobreviviente y los eventos tóxicos con Dog.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Maggie, Gabriel y Aarón buscan comida y suministros para llevarlos de regreso a Alejandría, utilizando el mapa de Maggie. En su búsqueda de una ubicación más, encuentran un escondite, pero la fe se rompe y el optimismo se resquebraja.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La misión de Maggie lleva al equipo a través de un túnel del metro plagado de zombis y con el problema añadido de Negan. En el grupo de Eugene, Yumiko busca respuestas acerca de su hermano.

programme.desc: Connie y Virgil se esconden en una casa ocupada por misteriosas criaturas, en su afán de escaparse de los caminantes. Pope pone a prueba la lealtad de Daryl hacia los Reapers con una misión controvertida. Kelly deja Alexandria para buscar a Connie.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: Leandro Díaz

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Ronald da la orden de matar a Emiliano para que no abra la boca. Emiliano le confiesa a Felipe toda la verdad. Por otro lado, Rosario saca las cosas de Emiliano de la pensión. La manada intenta consolar a Rosario con una serenata.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El sicario contratado por Rubén tratará de asesinar a Emiliano. Con lo que no cuenta el criminal, es que el mariachi se sabe defender muy bien. Los cabecillas de la organización deberán buscar una nueva estrategia para mantener en silencio a Emiliano

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Para evitar que Emiliano se declare inocente y la policía descubra quienes son los verdaderos culpables del lavado de dólares, los socios de Corona deciden contratar a los mariachis y en medio de la serenata, se toman fotos junto a Rosario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano es visitado por Corona y éste le muestra las fotos en que Rosario aparece junto a los cabecillas de la organización. Emiliano no tendrá otra opción que acceder a las pretensiones del abogado. Por otro lado, Rosario recibe la visa mexicana.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El comandante Salas revisa el interrogatorio y empieza a dudar de la culpabilidad de Emiliano. Por otro lado, Rosario no puede entrar al reclusorio por ser Emiliano un preso de alta seguridad. Rosario buscara la ayuda de la teniente Morales.

programme.title: Diomedes

programme.title: Diomedes

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Rosa tiene una discusión con Icho porque ella le reclama por una supuesta amante de él, quien termina siendo su hermana. Icho dolido decide romper con el compromiso de su matrimonio.

programme.title: Diomedes

programme.title: Diomedes

programme.desc: Zuky le exige a Johan 30 mil dólares, él la contrató para un video y le mordió una nalga. Un stripper pide indemnización porque en una despedida de soltera le desgarraron los testículos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La hija de Daniel y Ray tiene problemas motores, la madre la sobreprotege y él quiere que la niña tenga una vida normal. Alejandro demanda a su madre biológica, exige que desaloje la casa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nally acusa al guardia de seguridad, Osiris, de haber permitido el crimen de su esposo. Indra fue detenida en su cita de inmigración por portar un arma, ella jura que no sabía que la tenía.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: José Luis se venga de Rosario quien de joven lo violó con un palo de billar, él le hizo lo mismo. Cinthya denuncia a su cuñado y al padre de este por el abuso continuado y muerte de su hermana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Víctor ha estado preso y ahora quiere confesar un crimen, pero su esposa se opone, asegura que él es inocente. Nathalie es perseguida por la mafia rusa porque la confunden con su amiga Valery.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Deborah le regala un restaurante a Alejandro y ahora se lo quiere quitar, pero él lo perdió. Además, la hija de Gabriel y Paola es una niña muy delgada, solo come verduras y mira las calorías.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nicolás consume salvia como droga, sus efectos alucinógenos son potentes, su esposa le pide el divorcio. Yohaly y Marianela se disputan 350 mil dólares de herencia, pero no hay testamento.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Eduardo tiene hijos, esposa y amante, en una festividad se vieron todos y acabó mal. En otro caso, Carlos y Katiuska descubrieron que Ámbar, la niñera de su hijo, es una ex drogadicta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Juan quiere que María le pague porque lo secuestró y lo violó en venganza por propasarse con su hija adolescente. Anisley despide a Sandro de su empresa por violento, pide orden de alejamiento.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tiene una hija con leucemia y ella le echa la culpa al padre. Ashley va al restaurante de Carlos con urgencia de ir al baño y al negárselo, no tiene más opción que defecar delante de todos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luisa casa a su hija discapacitada con Andrés para optar por un tratamiento y ahora que la joven recibe una herencia quiere divorciarlos. Demandan a Jaime por publicar una noticia falsa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María contrata a unos actores vestidos de policía para intimidar a su hijo descarriado, pero todo resulta mal. Zoraida se da cuenta de que York finge accidentes para cobrar la indemnización.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: A Cándida le roban el auto en el garaje de la tienda donde trabaja y la despiden, ahora demanda a la exjefa. Javier acusa a Naomi de los destrozos en su casa y la aparición de drogas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lenin ordena desconectar a su mujer con muerte cerebral y se va a EE.UU., pero ella vive para reclamar lo suyo. Carlos construye una familia virtual y le da más valor que a su familia real.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Detienen a Conni por tráfico de marihuana, su esposo puso la droga en su equipaje y ella no lo sabía. Andrea es un transexual que demanda a Eliza, dueña de un hotel, por discriminación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Raymond es cantante, pero no quiere cumplir su contrato con la productora porque en lugar de promover su música lo usan para vender drogas. Lucí­a dice que no en plena boda y estafa al novio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El esposo de Katherine muere en una celda policial sin agua, comida y sin que nadie lo supiera. El hermano de Scarlett busca ayuda en el restaurante de Jean tras ser herido, pero se la niegan.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una señora y su acompañante desaparecieron, le reclaman a las hijas que revelen el paradero. Por una cerca que nadie repone, un petardo impacta a una embarazada y le causa un aborto.

programme.title: Dark Nemesis
programme.desc: A group of desperate soldiers hatch a plan to steal a Warlord's treasure and start a new life. Faced with the threat of a horrific death at the hands of the Warlord's executioners, the men escape into a desolate and forbidden land known only as the Shadowlands. Starring Kyle Walsh, Aaron Farb, Debra Lopez

programme.title: Corrado
programme.desc: A ruthless mafia hit man is transformed when he rescues a woman who takes the fall for one of his hits. Starring Tom Sizemore, Tony Curran, Johnny Messner

programme.title: Displacement
programme.desc: A young physics student must find a way to reverse a deadly quantum time anomaly and solve the murder of her boyfriend while battling short-term memory loss and time slips caused by the event. - Starring Courtney Hope, Susan Blakely, Bruce Davison

programme.title: Brain Dead
programme.desc: The story of six people caught in the unusual (except in horror films) predicament of being stranded in a deserted fishing lodge with a host of alien-infected, mutant amoeba-controlled zombies at their doorstep.

programme.title: Butterfly
programme.desc: NICK COLE, a straight-to-video horror director who is kidnapped by, LANEY, an over zealous fan, determined to impress him with her own film project. The situation goes from bad to worse when Cole realizes that the murders in Laney's film are real, and that the victims are all people from his own dark past. Starring Mandi Kreisher, Jay Laisne, Sky Kelley

programme.title: Blood and Steel: Cedar Crest Country Club
programme.desc: The story of an 80’s skateboarding mecca, tucked in the woods of a country club, that drew some of the best up-and-coming skaters and punk bands from across the country. From the mouths of the rebels who lived it, hear how one ramp became a legend. - Starring Tony Hawke, Ian MacKaye, Bucky Lasek

programme.title: Border Blues
programme.desc: A dangerous smuggler helps an attractive woman and her 5-year-old daughter, while a police chief pursues a mad bomber in Los Angeles. Starring Eric Roberts, Gary Busey, Rodion Nahapetov

programme.title: Captain Orellana and the Possessed Village
programme.desc: Captain Orellana, a former police investigator has been tapped for the wackiest, most dangerous case of his long career. He’s hired to examine the strange occurrences in a remote village in which many of the villages seem to be … POSSESSED! With 007-like swagger Orellana takes on the challenge.

programme.title: Cannibal
programme.desc: Max is agoraphobic and lives in a cabin in the middle of nowhere. One night, he finds a beautiful unconscious woman (Bianca). Her body is covered with blood.

programme.title: Brackenmore
programme.desc: Upon news of her uncle's death, Kate must return to her family home in the tiny rural village of Brackenmore, where the eccentric, wary residents are hiding a dark secret that entangles Kate in a dangerous, cultish design.

programme.title: Blue Family
programme.desc: Based on true events, Blue Family follows the charming used car salesman Armando as he works on creating a perfect family. For underneath his sunny disposition, lies a dark secret. In an attempt to make up for a childhood of abuse and the family he never had, he hand picks his own family by kidnaping three attractive young women.

programme.title: CERN & The Sense of Beauty
programme.desc: An exploration of the link between science and beauty through the work of scientists at CERN, in Geneva.

programme.title: Bunny The Killer Thing
programme.desc: A group of Finnish and British people get stuck at a cabin when they are attacked by a creature that is a half human, half rabbit.

programme.title: Charlotte
programme.desc: A teenage girl is baby sitting at a new house when she's accosted by a vicious, possessed doll. With the baby sitter in bondage, the toy subjects her to a series of terrifying tales on the television, each story more twisted than the last.

programme.title: Bled White
programme.desc: The dead feast on human flesh and stop at nothing for it. The living, confined to the dark corners of the world, must do what it takes to survive.

programme.title: Bait
programme.desc: Two women with aspirations of opening their own business borrow money from a loan shark, but when his terms turn violent, they're forced into bloody retaliation.

programme.title: Ashes
programme.desc: After the death of his beloved wife in a devastating fire, Jonathon Soter's life is in ruins. Drinking to excess and barely holding down his job as a teacher, he's a man lost with nothing to live for. But the sudden news that the boy who killed his wife, Donald McKinley, has been released early from prison, brings monumental change for Soter and gives him a new motivation. programme.title: Great Destinations Africa
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Sarah Graham’s Food Safari
programme.desc: Food blogger and cookbook author, Sarah Graham, takes her kitchen on the road through Africa.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: The history of the Duchy of Urbino is really the history of two families: the Montefeltros and the Della Roveres, nobles and patrons who bid for everlasting fame with architectural and artistic works. Their efforts resulted in the painting The Flagellation of Christ, the rooms of the Ducal Palace, the Guest apartment with the King Of England's Room, the Throne Room and the Chapel of Guidubaldo.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In this episode, chef Mirciny Moliviatis shows us how to cook a traditional Guatemalan dish, and we explore a local street market. We meet Juan Pablo Fuentes, who's transforming education with his student-first approach.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave & Kari visit Hawaii and take a Helicopter tour of the volcano national park.

programme.title: Exotic Destinations 101
programme.desc: Exotic Destinations 101 is a docuseries that explores hidden pieces of paradise around the globe. Each episode will feature stunning landscapes of a particular continent, diving into what Asia, Africa, America, Oceania and Europe have to offer, perfect.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and Nick road trip to Cape May, NJ and discover a town that is preserved in the Victorian Era. Join them as they feast on fresh caught seafood, search for diamonds, and blast off on a jet boat!

programme.title: Great Destinations Africa
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Aimed at the adventure seeker, Departures is an action-packed and personal journey about two travelers. Scott Wilson and Justin Lukach leave their lives behind in search of unique experiences through some of the most beautiful and remote places on earth.

programme.title: Follow Alana Switzerland
programme.desc: Follow Alana Switzerland highlights the pastoral beauty of Switzerland's countryside and alpine scapes, delving into iconic Swiss culture and giving viewers a glimpse of what it's like to travel in the country's rural and urban settings.

programme.title: Follow Alana Switzerland
programme.desc: Follow Alana Switzerland highlights the pastoral beauty of Switzerland's countryside and alpine scapes, delving into iconic Swiss culture and giving viewers a glimpse of what it's like to travel in the country's rural and urban settings.

programme.title: Leave No Trace
programme.desc: Ancient Siam meets privacy and 'Intelligent Luxury' at Soneva Kiri, an award-winning luxury resort located on Thailand's 4th largest island, Koh Kood. Soneva are a thriving community working closely with the environment to craft incredible bespoke experiences, where discovery is a way of life. Richard learns about Soneva's "waste to wealth" policy, and visits Mandalay to learn more about the Soneva Foundation's Myanmar Stoves Campaign.

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Competition, controversy, and land that sell for 1M an acre! Napa Valley is the quintessential American wine region. It helped the USA gain the recognition it deserved in the wine world, and to this day still brings the thunder; but do you know the story of how it came to be? Find out on the premiere episode of V is for Vino.

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: Chef Massimo Capra explores the Belle Isle area, one of the most beautiful settings in Northern Ireland. He meets-up with Chef Liz Moore and together they find giant sized rhubarb plants (really, they are taller than Massimo), meet the local butcher to get a pork belly and they make special sausages. Chef Liz has previously prepared a meal or two for the Queen of England. The Pressure is on Chef Massimo. Both have fun preparing a feast that will be served for a very elegant array of guests in a Royal dining room no less…this will be a meal fit for royalty!

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: The village of Lunenburg is known as the fishing capital of Canada. Chef Massimo joins forces with his friend Chef Konrad Haumering who gets the freshest mussels, halibut, lobster, scallops right off of the fishermen’s boats as they are brought in daily. All this happens within a short walk from his restaurant, truly right in front of his doors. They get the fresh catch of the day, a huge Flounder fish and they accentuate the meal by adding lobster. Massimo injects his Italian influence into the cooking while Chef Konrad adds his German flare resulting in a perfect ocean treat for their guests.

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: The village of Lunenburg is known as the fishing capital of Canada. Chef Massimo joins forces with his friend Chef Konrad Haumering who gets the freshest mussels, halibut, lobster, scallops right off of the fishermen’s boats as they are brought in daily. All this happens within a short walk from his restaurant, truly right in front of his doors. They get the fresh catch of the day, a huge Flounder fish and they accentuate the meal by adding lobster. Massimo injects his Italian influence into the cooking while Chef Konrad adds his German flare resulting in a perfect ocean treat for their guests.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri se presta a consolar a Solimar al saberla herida por causa de la ruptura de su relación amorosa con Wilker | Solimar sintiéndose devastada por la decisión de su antiguo novio se confiesa ante Yubiri al hacerla participe del gran amor que albergaba por el muchacho a pesar de su platónica relación | Yubiri se deja atemorizar por la idea de haber sido el motivo de la decisión asumida por Wilker de terminar su noviazgo con Solimar | entre tanto su amiga le lanza una advertencia.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Gladis y Marco Aurelio acuerdan que será mejor vivir separados porque cada uno extraña su soledad, pero podrán verse cada que quieran. Después, él le da la noticia a Yesenia y ella se muestra feliz al saber que Gladis se mudará de ahí.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo cancela su boda con Celia a último momento tras admitir que no la ama y que sigue dolido por Manuela. Celia, devastada y humillada, expulsa a Ricardo de su casa y acusa a Manuela de ser su verdadera enemiga, jurando venganza. Mientras tanto, María del Pilar se refugia en Gustavo tras ser plantada por Marcelo, y Margot amenaza a Benjamín Malaver para obtener seguridad. El conflicto familiar escala cuando Elizabeth confronta a su padre por su falta de honestidad emocional.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro acepta llevar el caso de la hija de Consuelo. Carmen intuye que Erasto es el secuestrador. Rosalia presiona la boda; Marisela arma escándalo a Alberto por el chantaje. Erasto, orgulloso del embarazo de Natalia, pide ayuda a Consuelo para encontrarla. Alejandro y Rosalía se casan; Marisela se aparece en plena celebración. Rosa sufre en silencio mientras Junior la consuela. Carmen jura venganza al ver el dolor de su hija. Consuelo enfrenta a Erasto exigiendo la verdad y le revela que lo denunció ante la fiscalía.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: María Lucía tiene una cita con Damián. Pero se encuentra a Leo quien volvió de Europa dispuesto a recuperarla. Julio se entera del regreso de su hermano y encuentra en la licenciada Altamirano una manera de causarle problemas. Agustina le pide a Rebeca dinero de su cuenta en Suiza para ponerla a prueba. Trinidad está cansada de que Irene ayude a Leonardo. Pero él va a la casa de Irene para pedirle un favor, ya que es la única que puede resolver el problema de la empresa.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto tiene extorsionado a Anselmo, y lo usa para salir de la cárcel. Cuando ambos van a la casa de Sol, ella le dice la verdad a Heriberto sobre sus sentimientos y le confiesa que la única manera de que terminen juntos es que Alejandro sea su hermano. Reina se encuentra en la prisión con Alicia, que va para pedirle a su madre que la ayude a sacar del medio a Maricielo. A cambio de ese favor Alicia ha alterado los resultados de la prueba de ADN de Sol y Alejandro.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca le da algo de plata a su hermana para que deje de desconfiar de ella. Pero Agustina sigue temiendo de lo que pueda hacer Rebeca, por lo que va a hablar con Carlos Ernesto porque quiere colaborar con la investigación y se entera de que él ya sabe sobre la infidelidad de su hermana. Irene acepta ir de viaje con Leonardo para ayudarlo a salvar a la empresa. Pero decide viajar también con Maribel para que le dé una mano con el bebé. Alejandra se enoja al enterarse del viaje de Leonardo e Irene. Leo se reencuentra con su familia. Y su regreso hace que María Lucía no se lo pueda sacar de la cabeza.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Anselmo ayuda a Heriberto a escapar de la cárcel. Heriberto visita por sorpresa a Sol en su mansión, dispuesto en llevarla a la cama. Sol da muchas vueltas con el asunto, y a pesar que le incomoda dormir con él, está segura que él es impotente y que no podrá hacerle nada. Alejandro la ve antes que se acueste, y ella le cuenta que irá a dormir con Madroño. Alejandro no puede tolerarlo, especialmente cuando el doctor Hernández lo ha llamado para citarlo y comentarle algo sobre el cotejo genético.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Botero eleva su protesta al sentirse víctima de la injusta decisión de Finita al creer a su esposa sin motivos para hacerlo pasar por la penuria de un divorcio. La familia Gamboa hace un recuento de su agotador día al haber colaborado cada uno con su aporte para hacer lucir su casa con un alegre ambiente navideño | ROKUro y Segundo se retiran de la sala al presentir la extensa conversación que advierten las mujeres de la familia al sentirse afectadas por causa del despecho asumido por Solimar.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Eden llega a casa de Pascua para hablar con ella, pero se lleva una gran sorpresa al verla llegar muy contenta con Moncho tomados de la mano. Rómulo está en el aeropuerto para irse al Orinoco, pero dentro de él espera que Egleé impida que se vaya.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia jura venganza contra Ricardo tras ser plantada. Él se refugia con la Nona, sintiéndose solo por dejar a Celia por conciencia. Hortensia, influenciada por Benjamín, planea sacar a Ricardo de las empresas, mientras Malaver busca apoderarse de todo. Brigitte causa caos con un cuchillo antes de ser llevada por Misael. Celia confronta a los Tariffi en un arranque de furia, reafirmando su amor antes de desmayarse. Ricardo enfrenta a Malaver, quien exige su fortuna y a Hortensia.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Adolfo despide a Isaías en un viaje de negocios. Rosa empieza a trabajar con Junior, que aprovecha para declararle su amor. Alejandro y Rosalía celebran su luna de miel mientras ella exhibe su falso embarazo. Natalia llega a la fiesta de René en mal estado tras un aborto clandestino. Erasto descubre el escondite de Natalia, denuncia a René por el aborto y toma a Natalia como prisionera. Junior presiona a Rosa para casarse. Alejandro logra liberar a Marisela. Alberto chantajea a Rosalía hasta que Alejandro lo descubre. Consuelo y Adolfo enfrentan juntos a Erasto exigiendo la verdad.

programme.desc: Celia jura venganza contra Ricardo tras ser plantada. Él se refugia con la Nona, sintiéndose solo por dejar a Celia por conciencia. Hortensia, influenciada por Benjamín, planea sacar a Ricardo de las empresas, mientras Malaver busca apoderarse de todo. Brigitte causa caos con un cuchillo antes de ser llevada por Misael. Celia confronta a los Tariffi en un arranque de furia, reafirmando su amor antes de desmayarse. Ricardo enfrenta a Malaver, quien exige su fortuna y a Hortensia.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Adolfo despide a Isaías en un viaje de negocios. Rosa empieza a trabajar con Junior, que aprovecha para declararle su amor. Alejandro y Rosalía celebran su luna de miel mientras ella exhibe su falso embarazo. Natalia llega a la fiesta de René en mal estado tras un aborto clandestino. Erasto descubre el escondite de Natalia, denuncia a René por el aborto y toma a Natalia como prisionera. Junior presiona a Rosa para casarse. Alejandro logra liberar a Marisela. Alberto chantajea a Rosalía hasta que Alejandro lo descubre. Consuelo y Adolfo enfrentan juntos a Erasto exigiendo la verdad.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Dos mujeres campesinas rescatan a Rosa del encierro pero la abandonan en la montaña. Alejandro y José Luis son auxiliados por una grúa. Erasto es encontrado inconsciente y robado por campesinos. Rosa lo encuentra al borde del precipicio y arriesga su propia vida para salvarlo, sin saber que es el asesino de Carlos y el secuestrador. Erasto se arrepiente del atentado contra su vida. Marisela acepta el divorcio de Adolfo y aboga por Isaías en su empresa. Consuelo niega volver con Isaías. Natalia confiesa a René que está embarazada de Erasto y pide ayuda para abortar.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: René celebra su graduación como médico. Carmen Rosa exige el alta del hospital para buscar a su hija. Arminda libera a Natalia creyendo a Erasto desaparecido. José Luis publica los crímenes de Erasto en la prensa. Vilma acosa a Salvador tras su ruptura. Adolfo descubre la campaña sucia en su contra y culpa a Erasto. Natalia pide a René acabar con su embarazo. Arminda consulta las piedras y ve la muerte de Erasto, anunciándola a Consuelo. En la carretera Rosa desorientada busca ayuda; Alejandro y José Luis la auxilian sorprendidos.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro y José Luis llevan a Rosa al hospital descubriendo su maltrato. Consuelo interroga a Arminda sobre la supuesta muerte de su padre. Carmen Rosa defiende a Rosa enfrentando a Blanca. Rosa convence a Alejandro de ir a rescatar a Erasto. Andreína sospecha que Alejandro y Rosa se fugaron. Junior descubre que el embarazo de Rosalía es falso y la enfrenta. Marisela desprestigia a Rosa ante Junior. Erasto recibe noticias del verdadero embarazo de Natalia y se arrepiente del plan contra Rosa. Adolfo incluye a Consuelo en sus planes futuros tras el divorcio.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro acepta llevar el caso de la hija de Consuelo. Carmen intuye que Erasto es el secuestrador. Rosalia presiona la boda; Marisela arma escándalo a Alberto por el chantaje. Erasto, orgulloso del embarazo de Natalia, pide ayuda a Consuelo para encontrarla. Alejandro y Rosalía se casan; Marisela se aparece en plena celebración. Rosa sufre en silencio mientras Junior la consuela. Carmen jura venganza al ver el dolor de su hija. Consuelo enfrenta a Erasto exigiendo la verdad y le revela que lo denunció ante la fiscalía.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri se muestra perturbada ante la irrupción de Wilker en sus pensamientos ante el reproche de Yubiri Juan Diego se decide a acomodar lo acontecido con su frustrado compromiso para su beneficio al recordarle a Yubiri que cayo preso debido a su estadía en el barrio | Yubiri se deja halagar por la justificación de Juan Diego al retomar nuevamente su idea de haber sido la causa que permitió que el muchacho no se comprometiese | Juan Diego se aprovecha de la situación.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la oficina de producción cinematográfica Graciela recibe la llegada de Gisela quien se muestra interesada en encontrarse con el Junior para comentar el guión de la película | Graciela escudriña en sus recuerdos al intentar memorizar la cara de Gisela al esta parecerle conocida con anterioridad | Gisela por su parte se confiesa abiertamente ante Graciela al tener la misma sensación de haber conocido a la muchacha con anterioridad | Junior interrumpe la conversación entre ambas mujeres.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la oficina de Atanasio Briggite se llena de encanto para intentar explicarle a su jefe lo halagada que se siente al creerse convertida en su amante por falsos sucesos que solo ella alberga en su suposición | Atanasio guarda silencio mientras Briggite realiza el relato de la supuesta y apasionada noche que pasaron juntos | a pesar de su idea principal de intentar resolver la problemática existente en la frágil relación entre Carolina y su hijo Atanasio corrobora la versión de Briggite.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri se presta a consolar a Solimar al saberla herida por causa de la ruptura de su relación amorosa con Wilker | Solimar sintiéndose devastada por la decisión de su antiguo novio se confiesa ante Yubiri al hacerla participe del gran amor que albergaba por el muchacho a pesar de su platónica relación | Yubiri se deja atemorizar por la idea de haber sido el motivo de la decisión asumida por Wilker de terminar su noviazgo con Solimar | entre tanto su amiga le lanza una advertencia.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Botero eleva su protesta al sentirse víctima de la injusta decisión de Finita al creer a su esposa sin motivos para hacerlo pasar por la penuria de un divorcio. La familia Gamboa hace un recuento de su agotador día al haber colaborado cada uno con su aporte para hacer lucir su casa con un alegre ambiente navideño | ROKUro y Segundo se retiran de la sala al presentir la extensa conversación que advierten las mujeres de la familia al sentirse afectadas por causa del despecho asumido por Solimar.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Katiuska seduce a Ricardo, provocando el llanto de Manuela. En la junta, Benjamín Malaver intenta destituir a Ricardo, pero Manuela lo respalda y frustra el plan. María del Pilar es agredida y miente para protegerse. Celia invita a Moisés y su abuela a vivir con ella, enfrentando la oposición de Benjamín. Margot investiga la identidad real de Malaver. Finalmente, Manuela planea vender sus acciones para una clínica, mientras Katiuska vuelve a manipular a un confundido Ricardo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo y Manuela firman su divorcio. Ricardo entra en depresión y rechaza una fiesta organizada por Katiuska, mientras Celia celebra erróneamente creyendo que él le pedirá matrimonio. Manuela se muda al barrio y planea luchar por Glorita. Amparo, al cuidado de Moisés y la enfermera Laura Valentina, no logra comunicarse. Hortensia regresa de vacaciones y encuentra la casa en caos por los excesos de Katiuska, mientras intenta ayudar a un Ricardo que solo desea estar solo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo, deprimido tras su divorcio, decide casarse con Celia por compromiso, desatando la furia de Hortensia. Mientras la Nona lo insta a luchar por Manuela, esta última decide abandonar su vida acomodada para vivir en un barrio. Paralelamente, María del Pilar sale con Gustavo ante la ausencia de Marcelo. Juan Marcos queda impactado por la boda de su padre y recibe el llamado de Elizabeth, quien considera que las decisiones de sus padres son una locura.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo cancela su boda con Celia a último momento tras admitir que no la ama y que sigue dolido por Manuela. Celia, devastada y humillada, expulsa a Ricardo de su casa y acusa a Manuela de ser su verdadera enemiga, jurando venganza. Mientras tanto, María del Pilar se refugia en Gustavo tras ser plantada por Marcelo, y Margot amenaza a Benjamín Malaver para obtener seguridad. El conflicto familiar escala cuando Elizabeth confronta a su padre por su falta de honestidad emocional.

programme.title: Tras el Cristal
programme.desc: Durante la II Guerra Mundial, el doctor Klaus torturó, abusó y mató a niños deportados. Un intento de suicidio lo obliga a permanecer conectado a un pulmón de acero. La aparición de un niño que se ofrece a cuidarlo establece una siniestra relación de deseo, venganza y apropiación de personalidad.

programme.title: La forma del bosque
programme.desc: Andrés y Silvia, dos hermanos que viven con su abuelo en una casa en medio del bosque, desatan la ira de una entidad oscura que los perseguirá sin descanso hasta atraparlos, durante el transcurso de una noche. Los niños deben encontrar las debilidades de la entidad para sobrevivir hasta el amanecer y así liberarse de la maldición.

programme.title: Tras el Cristal

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Es un misterio por qué una ancianita está rompiendo reflectores frente a un centro turístico costero recién construido. El equipo pronto descubre que ZARA está tratando de ayudar a las tortugas recién nacidas a llegar desde sus nidos hasta el mar. Pero la confusa contaminación lumínica no es la única amenaza que enfrentan, los depredadores acechan y un derrame de petróleo en el mar las espera. Es una batalla en tres frentes para salvar a las tortugas, pero los niños tienen tres cosas a su favor: superpoderes, gran inteligencia y redes de seda de araña sintética.

programme.title: Silencio en la nieve
programme.desc: En plena Segunda Guerra Mundial, un asesino en serie aparece dentro de la División Azul, cuerpo de soldados españoles voluntarios que combatieron en el frente ruso junto a las tropas alemanas. Tras el hallazgo del cadáver de un soldado español que ha sido degollado y presenta en el hombro una inscripción grabada a cuchillo ("Mira que te mira Dios"), se abre una investigación de la que se encarga el soldado Arturo Andrade, que asume la tarea con rigor y profesionalidad. Arturo cuenta con la ayuda del Sargento Espinosa, y pronto ambos empiezan a sospechar que detrás del asesinato se ocultan oscuros secretos del pasado.

programme.title: Kill Kane
programme.desc: Un hombre busca venganza cuando su esposa e hijos son asesinados a manos de una pandilla despiadada. Dado por muerto y sin nadie a quien recurrir, sale a la calle en busca de justicia y toma el asunto en sus propias manos.
